Empires & Puzzles Cel Review: The Unmovable Object vs. Modern Power Creep

Cel brings massive Rock Golems and the unique Stoneskin mechanic to the battlefield. But with her Slow speed and aging stats, can she still hold the line against modern heavy hitters? We break down her strengths, weaknesses, and where she fits in the current meta.
Cel Review: The Unmovable Golem Queen

Cel, the Masked Goddess of Earth, arrived in July 2023 as part of the Carnival of Gods (Masquerade) family. She is a Slow 5-star Ice summoner designed to turn your team into a fortress of rock and stone. Her gimmick is simple but potent: massive minions that grant "Stoneskin," reducing damage to a single digit. While she was once a formidable tank, the years haven't been kind to her speed or her stats.

Cel’s design is a striking blend of elegance and brutalism. She wears a golden mask and holds a lantern that looks like it contains the souls of players who forgot to bring a minion dispeller. The giant floating stone head next to her (presumably the Golem source) gives off major "judging your board manipulation skills" vibes. It is a fantastic piece of art that perfectly captures the "Masquerade" theme—beautiful but unsettling.

Here is the hard truth: Cel's stats are showing their age. With a base Power of 933, she is significantly behind modern heroes who regularly push past 1260 Power. Her defensive stats (906 Defense / 1775 Health) were top-tier in 2023 but are now merely "average" compared to the 1300+ Defense and 2400+ Health titans released in late 2025. This stat gap means her minions, which scale off her HP, are not as terrifyingly beefy as they once were unless heavily invested with Alpha Aethers and high-level troops.

Upon release, Cel was a frustrating tank to face. Her minions were nearly unkillable for rosters lacking specific counters, and the Stoneskin made sniping her team a nightmare.

The game has evolved towards "Fast" and "Very Fast" dominance. Minion counters (Grimble, Ogima, and newer heroes like Hotspin) are everywhere. Furthermore, the sheer damage output of modern heroes means her minions, while beefy, can be wiped out much faster than before.
Cel is no longer a top-tier war tank. She is too slow and has too many hard counters. However, she remains a queen of
wars and tournaments. In PvE (Map Stages, Towers), she is essentially a "Win Button"—once you get her minions up, your team becomes almost immortal against mob waves.

If you pulled Cel early, congratulations! You just unlocked "Easy Mode" for the map seasons. Focus on keeping her alive with healers. Do not worry about her slow speed in map stages; use mana potions if needed. She will carry you through hard bosses.

She is a luxury hero for Rush Wars. Unless you lack a strong Rush tank, she is likely not worth the Alpha Aethers compared to modern stats monsters. If you do use her, ensure she is flanked by heroes that punish the enemy for trying to dispel or kill minions.
The community has always had a love-hate relationship with Cel.
Players were baffled by her class. One user noted,
"Not one paid employee thought she should be of any class other than DRUID is mind blowing. That’s the one class that actually works against her special skill."
Many felt she needed "one more skill" to justify the Slow speed.

despite the complaints, everyone agrees she is a monster in Rush.

Cel is a relic of a time when "Slow" meant "Game Ending." In today's hyper-fast meta, she is often too slow to make an impact before the battle is decided. However, she remains an absolute unit in PvE and Rush modes. She is a specialized tool, not a Swiss Army knife. If you need a wall, she is your girl. Just don't expect her to win a foot race.
